tasks.title: Owner accepts ADR-001 and v2 docs
tasks.description: Owner reviews docs/PRD.md, MVP, ARCHITECTURE, DIRECTIVES and ADR-001, then accepts or amends them. OWNER TASK.
tasks.details:
Set ADR-001 status to accepted; choose license; confirm package name (default jangus2); make the docs branch the default branch of jangus-2.0.

[2026-11-01T18:20:18-05:00] Docs and task list prepared on branch phase-0/taskmaster; waiting on owner to review ADR-001 and decide license/package name.
tasks.testStrategy: ADR-001 status reads 'accepted' on the default branch; LICENSE file present or decision logged in the PRD decision log.

tasks.title: Scaffold repo, tooling and CI
tasks.description: Python 3.12 project with uv, ruff, mypy, pytest and a CI workflow.
tasks.details: Create pyproject.toml (src layout, package jangus2), uv.lock, src/jangus2/__init__.py, tests/test_smoke.py, .github/workflows/ci.yml (ubuntu + windows matrix: ruff, mypy --strict on kernel, pytest). Pin versions; .gitignore for runtime data.
tasks.testStrategy: Run `uv run pytest`, `uv run ruff check`, `uv run mypy --strict src/jangus2/kernel`: all pass; CI green on both OSes.

tasks.title: Strict config and error types
tasks.description: Pydantic strict config models and stable fault codes.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/config.py: StrictModel base (extra=forbid), paths outside checkout, loopback-only model endpoint check (127.0.0.1, ::1), RuntimeFault(code). Port ideas from v1 config.py.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: invalid/extra fields rejected; non-loopback endpoint rejected; valid config loads.

tasks.title: SQLite state store with idempotency
tasks.description: Durable runs, actions, budgets tables with WAL and synchronous=FULL.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/state.py: schema v1, transactional intent+attempt charge, idempotency keys, schema version check. Port from v1 execution/storage.py.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: duplicate idempotency key returns same record; reopened DB keeps budgets; unreadable DB blocks writes.

tasks.title: Hash-chained audit ledger
tasks.description: Append-only ledger; each entry hashes the previous.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/ledger.py: append(event), verify_chain(), fail-closed on write error. Port from v1 remote/ledger.py.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: tamper with an entry and verify_chain fails; write failure raises and blocks new effects (B06).

tasks.title: Tool registry and tier policy
tasks.description: Registry of tools with schema, tier, reversibility, verify, reconcile; policy engine.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/registry.py + policy.py. Tool without verify+reconcile cannot be T2/T3. decide(tool, agent_max_tier) returns RUN, RUN_LOG, QUEUE or REJECT. Elevation rules (target outside workspace).
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B01-B04: unknown tool rejected; T1 runs, T2 runs+logs, T3 queues; call above max_tier rejected not queued; malformed args rejected.

tasks.title: Directive models and validation
tasks.description: Strict directive/task models, status rules, scope narrowing against a spec, linting with tasks.py.
tasks.details:
src/jangus2/directives/models.py per docs/DIRECTIVES.md: schema_version, goal, non_goals, budget, tasks with dependencies/testStrategy/tools. Validate: lower-id dependencies, tools subset of spec, tier ceiling <= spec max_tier, immutable hash recorded at issue. Status changes only via kernel API.

[adapt 2026-11-01 cost discipline] Add task field `runner` (kernel|model, default model) with `steps` for kernel-run tasks, and directive flag `escalate` (default false). Validate steps use only tools in the task's `tools`.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: directive asking for a tool outside the spec rejected; cyclic/forward dependency rejected; model-supplied status ignored; directive hash logged to ledger; kernel-run task with a tool outside its tools list is rejected (B29)

tasks.title: Kernel executor with intent, verify and reconcile
tasks.description: Core loop: persist intent, execute, verify, persist result; reconcile after crash.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/executor.py plus fake tools. Intent+attempt in one transaction before effect; independent verify; reconcile adopts matching result, retries only proven absence, otherwise marks unresolved.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B05: kill the process before effect, after effect before result, after verification; restart yields no duplicate or overwrite.

tasks.title: Secret resolver interface
tasks.description: Kernel resolves named secrets and injects them into a tool call only.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/secrets.py: Protocol, EnvBackend, fake backend for tests, WindowsCredentialBackend (keyring/pywin32, import-guarded) per agent allow-list. Never returns secrets to prompts or logs.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B07: agent without the secret named in spec gets denied; canary secret absent from ledger, logs, exports, error text.

tasks.title: Approval queue storage
tasks.description: Queue for T3 actions bound to payload hash, run id and expiry.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/kernel/approvals.py: enqueue, list, approve, reject, expire; approval valid only for the exact normalized payload hash.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: changed payload invalidates approval; expired approval refused; approve records owner id in ledger.

tasks.title: Phase 1 evidence, MEMORY update and PR
tasks.description: Collect B01-B07 evidence and open the Phase 1 PR.
tasks.details: Write docs/reviews/PHASE_1.md with commands run and actual outputs; update MEMORY.md current phase; open PR from phase-1/kernel.
tasks.testStrategy: PR open with CI green and evidence file listing pass/fail for B01-B07.

tasks.title: Agent spec schema, loader and approval registry
tasks.description: Load YAML specs; active only if SHA-256 is owner-approved.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/agents/spec.py and registry file outside the checkout; `jangus spec approve <file>` records the hash.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B09: edited spec inactive until re-approved; unapproved spec cannot run.

tasks.title: Model providers: Ollama, Claude, no silent fallback
tasks.description: One provider interface; loopback Ollama; Claude API; failure means stop and alert.
tasks.details: src/jangus2/agents/providers/*. Token/cost accounting; recorded-transcript tests; no network in unit tests.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B11: failing or disabled provider stops the run and alerts; never switches provider.

tasks.title: Durable budgets and spend cap
tasks.description: Calls, tokens, wall time and monthly USD survive restarts.
tasks.details: Extend state store; spend ledger entries; stop at cap with alert.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B08: exhausted budget persists after restart and new session.

tasks.title: Propose-then-execute run loop
tasks.description: Fresh run: build prompt, get structured proposals, kernel validates and executes, return results as data.
tasks.details:
src/jangus2/agents/runner.py with scripted fake model; external content wrapped as quoted data; loop ends on done/budget/error.

[adapt 2026-11-01 cost discipline] Run loop must meter calls/tokens/spend per role in the ledger and use the spec's cheap model; no orchestrator call anywhere in the loop.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B10, B12: second run receives nothing from the first; scripted proposals executed via the kernel only; ledger shows per-role usage (B30)

tasks.title: Directive runner (task-by-task execution)
tasks.description: Run a directive one task at a time with kernel-owned status and logs.
tasks.details:
src/jangus2/directives/runner.py: show only current task + verified dependency results; run testStrategy check via kernel verification; log from ledger IDs; stop rules (budget, unresolved effect, rejected T3, two failed attempts).

[adapt 2026-11-01 cost discipline] Kernel marks tasks done/blocked, finishes the directive and writes the run report from a fixed template with NO model call and no orchestrator confirmation. `runner: kernel` tasks execute scripted steps with zero model calls.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest: model claiming done does not set done; out-of-task tool call rejected; blocked directive halts and alerts; tasks.py validate lints a directive file; a full standing directive completes with zero orchestrator calls (B27) and kernel-run tasks use zero tokens (B29)

tasks.title: Local model benchmark script
tasks.description: Measure timing, RAM and tool-call reliability for candidate Ollama models. OWNER RUNS IT.
tasks.details: scripts/benchmark_ollama.py: fixed proposal-format prompts, JSON schema conformance rate, latency, cold load; output JSON kept out of Git.
tasks.testStrategy: Script runs against a fake server in tests; owner sends results from Windows.

tasks.title: File tool pack
tasks.description: Tools: file.list/read/hash (T1), file.copy_new/report.write (T2), file.delete/overwrite (T3).
tasks.details: src/jangus2/tools/files.py with workspace canonicalization, symlink/junction rejection, no silent overwrite, verify by SHA-256, reconcile by inspecting output.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B14: corrupted destination detected; traversal and symlink escapes rejected; overwrite/delete queue as T3.

tasks.title: Scheduler tick and daily report
tasks.description: `jangus tick` runs due agents, coalesces missed ticks; status and daily report.
tasks.details:
src/jangus2/cli.py + scheduler.py; cron-like triggers from specs; one run lock.

[adapt 2026-11-01 cost discipline] Scheduler launches standing directive templates directly for the assignee (orchestrator not involved). Daily report is built deterministically from the ledger, including per-role cost.
tasks.testStrategy: pytest B13: missed ticks coalesce; overlapping tick does not double-run; daily report totals match the ledger (B30)

tasks.title: Backup agent spec and directive template
tasks.description: First specialist: verified backups from a standing directive.
tasks.details:
agents/backup-maintainer.yaml + directives/templates/nightly-backup.json; owner names folders at approval time.

[adapt 2026-11-01 cost discipline] Backup agent's spec may use provider `none` (kernel-only): nightly backup directive is entirely `runner: kernel` tasks, so it costs zero tokens.
tasks.testStrategy: Scripted fake-model run completes the template directive; kernel verifies every copy; nightly backup runs end to end with zero model calls
